🔮 Worldbuilding Helper ▼
Mira
Ask me anything about your world
I'm Mira, your worldbuilding helper. I can see everything you've filled out in the scenario designer. Ask me to brainstorm, flesh out ideas, draft content, or suggest improvements.

👕 Fashion info has moved to the 👤 Characters tab. 🌍 World-building notes have moved to the 🗺️ World tab. 📦 Race configuration is in the 🧬 Races tab.

🌍 Setting & Environment Designer

Define the world's locations and environments. The AI will use these to generate consistent backgrounds and describe locations accurately. Basic mode lets you outline your setting in text; Advanced mode lets you create specific location templates with visual descriptions for the image generator.

🎨 Global Visual Style (optional)

Set a consistent visual style for ALL backgrounds in this scenario. This prevents architecture from randomly changing between scenes.

📦 Preset Bundle Library (import pre-built templates — optional)

Import a pre-built library of location templates from a stock scenario. This loads all the region, area, and location templates into the Location Builder below, where you can edit them.

📍 Location Builder

Build your world's geography in a cascading hierarchy: Region → Area → Location → Interior → Rooms. Create a region, add areas within it, then add locations to each area. Locations can be outdoor points of interest or indoor buildings — buildings have interiors (the main entry/hall), and each interior can have rooms. If a room has no visual description, the AI generates one based on the interior's architecture style.

+ Add Region
🌍 Location Helper (AI world generator)

Automatically generate entire regions, areas, locations, interiors, and rooms — or generate isolated locations. The helper reads your scenario description, writing style, world description, worldbuilding notes, lore entries, setting overview, and architecture style to create locations that fit your world. Generated locations appear in the Location Builder above as they are created.

⚙️ Generation Parameters
🏠 Interiors & Rooms (for indoor locations)
⚠️ Warning: Generating large worlds at once (many regions with many areas and locations) may take a very long time, cause this tab to run out of memory or become unresponsive, and could exceed API rate limits. If the generation is very large, consider generating in smaller batches instead. You can always generate more later and add to existing regions.
🏚️ Isolated Locations (reusable — optional)

Standalone locations not tied to any region. The AI can use these in any area where they make sense — perfect for generic locations like "a tavern", "a market stall", or "a back alley" that could appear anywhere in your world. Buildings can have interiors with rooms.

+ Add Isolated Location
🗺️ Scenario Map (cosmetic — optional)

Upload or describe a map for your scenario. Currently cosmetic only — it won't affect gameplay but helps you visualize the world.

🗺️ World Building

Define the broader rules and lore of your world. This reinforces the scenario description and is a primary resource for the AI worldbuilding assistants (coming soon). It will influence the story to a moderate degree.

🧬 Race System

Choose which races appear in your world, customize their profiles, sub-races, and cultures. The hierarchy is Race → Sub-race → Culture: each sub-race has its own set of cultures, appearance overrides, and traits. Click a race to expand, then a sub-race to see its cultures. Save and import individual sub-races and cultures from the libraries.

+ Add Race
📦 Race Library

Save your custom races, cultures, and sub-races here for easy import into future scenarios. Stock races can also be saved as modified copies.

Your saved races will appear here. Expand a race below and click "Save to Library" to store it.

🧬 Race Helper — AI Dashboard

Auto-generate race distributions, custom races, sub-races (variants), and cultures based on your scenario. The helper reads your description, writing style, world notes, and lore to produce contextually appropriate results that fit your world.

⚖️ Auto-Generate Race Distribution

Creates a custom race distribution (which races appear and at what weights) based on your scenario. Stock races and any custom races you've already defined will be considered.

🧬 Create Custom Race from Ideas

Describe a custom race and the AI will create a full definition (appearance, traits, variants, cultures). The race will be added to your scenario's race selection.

🔀 Create Custom Sub-Race (Variant) from Ideas

Describe a sub-race/variant and the AI will create a full variant definition. The variant will overwrite any overlapping traits from the base race. Select which race to generate it for, or choose "None" to save it directly to your variant library.

🎭 Create Custom Culture from Ideas

Describe a culture and the AI will create a full cultural definition. The culture will overwrite any overlapping traits from the race and sub-race. Select a race and optional sub-race to attach it to, or choose "None" to save it directly to your culture library.

🌟 Full Automated Race Generator

Give the AI an idea for the races of your world and it will generate complete races with sub-races and cultures. Multiple races can be generated at once. Each race gets the specified number of sub-races and cultures.

⚙️ Character Generation Rules

Set rules for how AI-generated characters are created. Fields you fill in will override random generation — leave blank for full randomness.

🚻 Character Gender Rules
Custom Gender Distribution

Set an exact gender mix. Each row = gender + percentage.

Custom Gender Creator

Define your own gender with specific body, genital, and appearance rules. Saved genders appear in the custom distribution selector above.

🔮 Character Helper — AI Dashboard

Auto-generate character rules, gender distributions, custom genders, and dialogue styles based on your scenario. The helper reads your description, writing style, world notes, and lore to produce contextually appropriate results.

⚙️ Auto-Generate Character Generation Rules

Fills in hair colors, eye colors, body types, personalities, fashion, and character directives based on your scenario. Existing values will be replaced.

🚻 Auto-Generate Custom Gender Distribution

Creates a custom gender distribution (percentages per gender) based on your scenario. This will set the NPC Gender Distribution to "Custom" and fill in the distribution.

⚧ Create Custom Gender from Ideas

Describe a custom gender and the AI will create a full definition (body, genitals, appearance, sprite notes). It will be saved to your custom gender library.

💬 Auto-Generate Dialogue Styles

Generates a global dialogue style and archetype-specific styles based on your scenario. Uses the global dialogue style box alongside scenario data. Generated styles are ADDED to your current list.

💬 Dialogue Style

Control how NPCs speak. Set a global dialogue style that applies to all characters, then optionally add archetype-specific styles that override it for certain character types (by gender, personality, occupation, etc.). This has a strong effect on dialogue — use it to give your story a distinct voice.

📋 Presets

Selecting a preset adds its styles to your current list — it does not replace them.

📚 Style Library

Save individual archetype styles to build a personal library you can reuse across scenarios.

+ Add Archetype-Specific Style

Create a dialogue style that overrides the global style for specific character types.

🔞 Adult Content Rating

Control what types of mature content appear in your scenario. Each category has an intensity level and a frequency. The global content rating (set on the startup page) combines with this — the higher of the two applies.

📖 Scenario Lore

Add key facts, secrets, or worldbuilding details organized by category. The AI pulls from these categories contextually — character lore for NPC generation, language lore for dialogue, plot lore for narration, etc. Set priority to control which entries the AI favors.

🔮 Lore Helper — AI Batch Generator

Automatically generate lore entries based on your scenario. The helper reads your description, writing style, world description, notes, and existing lore to create contextually relevant entries. Entries appear as they are generated.

🧬 Custom Gender Creator

📥 Import Lore

Load .txt files (or a direct .txt URL). Separate each lore entry with a blank line — the importer splits on blank lines and (optionally) sorts entries into lore categories by keywords. Review the preview below, then import.

🌐 Create Scenario from a URL

Paste a URL — a wiki article, a fandom/lore page, a setting guide, anything — and the AI will study it and auto-build a complete custom scenario from it: title, premise, writing style, world & locations, races, characters, dialogue, lore, and content rating. Everything lands in the Custom Scenario Designer, where you can review, edit, or regenerate any part before starting.

⚙️ Auto-generate parts

Uncheck anything you'd rather fill in yourself — only what's checked gets generated and applied.

⏳ Heads-up: this is the longest generation in the generator. Light takes ~2–4 minutes; Deep can take a quarter of an hour or more. A progress log shows each step and you can cancel anytime. The AI interprets the source page, so accuracy depends on the source — wiki and lore pages work best. Content comes from whatever site you paste, so treat it as an unofficial fan interpretation and double-check the 🔞 Content Rating tab afterward. Nothing is applied until the final step.
